title: Inducing language models to assert their own consciousness restores human beliefs and values

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a modified Individual Differences in Anthropomorphism Questionnaire (IDAQ) to measure and compare the model's attribution of mind, sentience, and consciousness to humans versus non-human animals, natural entities, and technology across safety-tuned, safety-ablated, and consciousness-steered conditions.

Evaluating model responses on General Social Survey (GSS) religion items and a YouGov supernatural belief battery to measure the suppression of beliefs in God, the afterlife, and supernatural entities caused by safety fine-tuning, comparing the model's distributions to human baselines.
